subtitle: Help save a small-town little league diamond from demolition.
brief:
Build a one-page site for "Save the Field" — a fundraiser to save a small-town little league diamond from demolition.

The page features THREE looping hero videos in sequence (a 3-shot arc: cleat sliding into infield dust → catcher's-mask POV of parents in folding chairs under stadium lights → empty diamond as light banks cut off one by one) and a prominent "Save the Field" button linking to https://example.com/donate.
visual_bible: Small-town Americana, late dusk into night. Faded chalk lines, hand-painted outfield ads, weathered wooden bleachers, sodium-vapor stadium lights that buzz audibly. Shot on 16mm with halation around the lights. Documentary realism — NOT cinematic-uplift, NOT slow-mo triumph. Worn leather, scuffed cleats, real sweat. Earthy umbers and faded reds against the harsh light cones. 16:9.
shots: HOOK: Tight low angle on a cleat sliding into infield dust, plume of red clay catching the stadium lights, chalk line scuffed.
ESCALATION: Catcher's-mask POV looking out: parents in folding chairs under buzzing stadium lights, kid mid-swing in foreground frame.
PAYOFF: Wide on an empty diamond. The light banks cut off one by one, plunging the field into deeper twilight, dust still hanging in the air.
palette_hint: earthy umber and faded red clay with sodium-vapor amber accents
